provenance.attribution: Co-authored by ApophisLee and GPT-6 Astra.
provenance.role_separation: The playground implementation, tests, and report were co-authored by ApophisLee and GPT-6 Astra. The recorded decisions were made by jaredpalmer/kev-4b.
provenance.publication_scope: Three selected historical synthetic arithmetic development traces; not a benchmark or an exhaustive collection of attempts.
provenance.source_retention: The successful arithmetic trace was recovered from the workspace reset archive. The interactive workspace has since been reused; live UI state is not the evidence record.

method.token_accounting: Exact native Kev encoder count of the complete decision request; checked against server-reported input usage. Cumulative tokens count each recorded decision once, not duplicated per-step totals.
method.latency_accounting: Sum of decision latency_ms values; not elapsed run wall time, GPU-only inference time, or tokens-per-second throughput.
method.task_conditioning: Task-specific fragment dictionary plus configured character alphabet; no complete program offered as a single fragment. Expected output is included in the task checks.
method.completion_gate: finish is available only after application checks pass; the model chooses whether to finish.
method.app_execution: The application uses a restricted Python-subset evaluator and does not execute submitted Python through the operating system.
method.filesystem_scope: Sandbox files are workspace-scoped; this is not an operating-system process sandbox.

independent_success_verification.method: First compared archived file and trace text with the exact reviewed source print(1 + 1) followed by a newline, then ran that source with python3 -I -c outside the application.

limitations: One successful arithmetic trace demonstrates feasibility only; it does not estimate reliability or general coding accuracy.
These selected development runs are not randomized, controlled A/B trials. Prompts, options, initial file state, and step budgets changed.
The successful trace uses only file creation, append fragments, and finish. It does not establish the effectiveness of reading, persistent memory, character entry, or repair.
Deterministic tests with mocked model decisions validate application contracts, not model accuracy.
Model decision probabilities are conditional on the options offered and are not calibrated estimates of program correctness.
The checker covers a restricted Python subset. Matching stdout is a narrower criterion than general semantic correctness.
Reported latency is from one local development setup, without a controlled warm-up, hardware, or scheduling comparison.
